name: Kurimoto,Ltd.
summary: Kurimoto,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of ductile iron pipes and accessories, valves, and industrial and construction materials in Japan and internationally. It operates through Lifeline Business, Machinery Systems Business, and Industrial Construction Materials Business segments. The company offers ductile iron pipes, valves, reinforced plastic, and disaster prevention products; disaster prevention products; resilient seated gate, butterfly, emergency shut-off, water level control and pressure regulating auto, orifice, float type, air, reversing, spherical, sleeve, slide gate, hot blast, link seal, goggle, and blow off valves; and sewerage, agricultural water, and well pipes.
